chains.label: 从「李二在桥边找灯笼」传成「李家眼红周家出风头，故意毁了桥」

failed.en: Something went wrong and the goods did not get there
failed.zh: 路上出了岔子，货没能送到

late.en: The delivery missed the agreed time
late.zh: 错过了约好的交货时间

rain.en: The heavy rain kept the goods off the road

taken_back.en: Word is the delivery was called off

clarified.en: {manager} compared the two accounts in public. After hearing both, {names} changed their minds.
clarified.zh: {manager}当众把两种说法一对，{names}听完改了口。

delivery.en: {who}'s delivery of {amount} poles of {item} reached the {place}.

entities.label: 点主灯的体面
entities.label_en: The Honour of Lighting the Main Lantern

evidence.label: 小满说，那晚看见一条船撞上栏杆
evidence.label_en: Xiaoman's account: a boat struck the railing that night

evidence.label: 账房记下的那笔修船账
evidence.label_en: The boat repair entry in the accountant's ledger

evidence.label: 桥墩上卡着从上游冲下来的断木
evidence.label_en: A broken piece of wood from upstream, wedged against the bridge pier

evidence.label: 更夫说，水冲上桥时，桥边没人
evidence.label_en: The watchman says nobody was near the bridge when the water struck it

evidence.label: 更夫说，桥下有个影子在撑船
evidence.label_en: The watchman says there was a figure with a boat pole under the bridge

evidence.label: 庙祝说，老何家那晚的灯一直亮到半夜
evidence.label_en: The temple keeper says a light was on at Boatman He's house until midnight

evidence.label: 周家伙计说，周家大郎那晚一回家就睡到了天亮
evidence.label_en: Zhou's Clerk says Zhou Dalang went straight to sleep when he got home and slept until dawn

evidence.label: 更夫说，看见周家大郎醉醺醺地上了桥
evidence.label_en: The watchman says Zhou Dalang staggered onto the bridge drunk

evidence.label: 断栏边的鞋印，近处能闻到酒气
evidence.label_en: A shoeprint by the broken railing, with a smell of wine nearby

evidence.label: 周家伙计说，自己只告诉过别人李二在桥边
evidence.label_en: Zhou's Clerk says Li Er was at the bridge and that's all the clerk told people

evidence.label: 李二说，那晚是在找掉进水里的灯笼
evidence.label_en: Li Er says he was looking for the lantern he dropped in the water that night

flags.label: 族长接受了当众说清的真相

any.label: 毁桥的谣言已经当众澄清，她自己知道了
给李家一个灯会上的体面角色，并且她对你的信任到一定程度
族长亲自开口，而族长先要被你说动

label: 断桥

metrics.label: 当众说清时在场的有名有姓的人数
在场者接受真相的百分比
终夜时相信主冲突假命题的有名有姓者百分比

observations.label: 李二在桥边找掉进水里的灯笼
桥墩上留着涨水时的水印
大郎昨夜在酒肆喝到很晚，今早不肯出门
老何的船身上有新刮痕

openings.label: 昨夜到今晨，「李二弄坏了栏杆」已经在周家和茶馆传开

bridge_mended.en: The Stone Bridge has reopened after repairs.
bridge_mended.zh: 石桥已经修好，两岸居民可以照常过桥。

evidence.en: {manager} showed the proof in public at the {place}. Some people believed it.
evidence.zh: {manager}在{place}当众拿出凭据，在场已有街坊信了这一说。

evidence_refused.en: {manager} showed the proof in public at the {place}. Nobody believed it.
evidence_refused.zh: {manager}在{place}当众拿出凭据，在场的街坊仍无人信这一说。

helpers.en: {n} more people agreed to help at the bridge.

meal.en: The heads of the Li and Zhou families shared a table, with neighbours there to see it.
meal.zh: 李、周两家的当家同桌吃饭，街坊也在场。

rain_heavy.en: Heavy rain fell {when}, and few people were out on the street.

reconciled.en: The heads of the Li and Zhou families have sat down together, and the families have made peace.
reconciled.zh: 李、周两家的当家一道坐过席，两家如今已经和好。

side_by_side.en: People from both families worked together at the bridge.
side_by_side.zh: 李、周两家都有人在桥边一起干活。

statement.en: {manager} spoke at the {place} about how the bridge broke, and some of the people there agreed.
statement.zh: {manager}在{place}当众讲了栏杆断裂的经过，在场有街坊听得点头。

statement_refused.en: {manager} spoke at the {place} about what happened at the bridge, but nobody there agreed.
statement_refused.zh: {manager}在{place}讲了自己查到的经过，在场的街坊听完都没有点头。

stopped.en: {who} has stopped speaking ill of {other} in public.
stopped.zh: {who}当着大家的面，不再说{other}的不是了。

truth_told.en: The evidence presented at a public meeting established how the Stone Bridge railing broke.
truth_told.zh: 石桥的栏杆是怎么断的，会上已经拿出凭据讲明。

work_stopped.en: Work on the bridge couldn't go on. {why}.

festival_cool.en: Hardly anyone mentions the festival. Some say they don't feel much like celebrating this year.
festival_cool.zh: 街上没几个人提灯会。有人说，今年怕是没什么兴致。

festival_down.en: Fewer people are looking forward to the festival than yesterday. It hardly comes up at the teahouse.
festival_down.zh: 茶馆里已经少有人提起灯会，街上盼着过节的人也比昨天少了。

festival_mixed.en: Some on the street look forward to the festival, and others want to wait and see.
festival_mixed.zh: 街上有人盼着灯会，也有人说再看看。

festival_up.en: More people are looking forward to the festival than yesterday. Children are asking when the lanterns go up.
festival_up.zh: 盼着灯会的居民比昨天多了，已有孩子在打听什么时候挂灯。

festival_warm.en: People in the street are talking about the festival. Some are already counting the lanterns at each door.
festival_warm.zh: 街坊议起灯会，已经有人在数各家门前挂几盏灯。

li_more.en: More people on the street than yesterday are speaking up for the Li family.
li_more.zh: 街上向着李家说话的人，比昨天又多了些。

li_side.en: More people on the street speak up for the Li family than for the Zhou family.
li_side.zh: 街上向着李家说话的人多些。

peace.en: Word has gone round that the heads of the Li and Zhou families sat down together.
peace.zh: 街上都在说，李、周两家的当家坐到一张桌上去了。

split.en: Some people speak up for the Li family, others for the Zhou family. Neither side has changed its mind.
split.zh: 街上有的替李家说话，有的替周家说话。说来说去，谁也没说服谁。

talked_out.en: People are still talking about what they heard in public. The old rumours come up less often.
talked_out.zh: 先前的闲话少有人提了，街坊如今说得多的，是那天当众讲明白的经过。

walk_call.en: There was more coming and going between neighbours yesterday. Some called on one another to talk.
walk_call.zh: 昨天街坊之间走动得多些。有人专程登门说话。

walk_hand.en: Some people lent a hand at the bridge yesterday.
walk_hand.zh: 昨天有人到桥边搭了把手。

walk_look.en: Some people made a point of going down to look at the bridge yesterday.
walk_look.zh: 昨天有人特地去桥边看了看。

zhou_more.en: More people on the street than yesterday are speaking up for the Zhou family.
zhou_more.zh: 街上向着周家说话的人，比昨天又多了些。

zhou_side.en: More people on the street speak up for the Zhou family than for the Li family.
zhou_side.zh: 街上向着周家说话的人多些。

speculation.label: 当时在现场，又与说话人所在的家结怨，就推测是这个人弄坏的
秋汛涨水，栏杆又塌了，就推测是汛水冲的
有人昨夜喝了酒，栏杆又塌了，就推测是这个人酒后弄坏的
船身有新刮痕，栏杆又塌了，就推测是船主撞的

text.en: Boatman He's boat struck the railing in the night
text.zh: 船夫老何夜里撑船，船头撞断了栏杆

text.en: The flood water loosened the old joints and the railing gave way by itself
text.zh: 秋汛的水头冲松了旧榫，栏杆自己断了

text.en: Zhou Dalang, drunk, kicked the railing down
text.zh: 周家大郎喝醉了酒，一脚踢断了栏杆

text.en: Li Er broke the railing
Boatman He poled under the bridge in the night and the bow struck the railing. Afterwards the boatman quietly mended the boat
text.zh: 船夫老何夜里撑船从桥下过，船头撞上了栏杆。事后老何悄悄把船修好了

text.en: The flood water loosened the old joints that night, and the railing gave way. There was nobody on or beneath the bridge at the time
text.zh: 出事那晚，水头冲松了桥栏里的旧榫，栏杆就这么断了。当时桥上桥下都没有人

text.en: Zhou Dalang got drunk at the tavern in the night, staggered onto the bridge and kicked the railing down
text.zh: 周家大郎那晚在酒肆喝醉了酒，摇摇晃晃地走上石桥，一脚踢断了栏杆

text.en: Li Er went to the bridge in the night and broke the railing
text.zh: 夜里李二到桥边，下手弄断了栏杆

text.en: Zhou's Clerk saw Li Er at the bridge looking for a lantern. Shopkeeper Zhou heard that and, remembering the old grudge, guessed that Li Er had broken the railing. By the time the neighbours heard, the story had picked up ‘on purpose’ and ‘envy’
text.zh: 周家伙计看见李二在桥边找灯笼。周掌柜听了，惦记两家的旧怨，就猜是李二弄断的。传到街坊耳朵里，又多出了「故意」和「眼红」

text.en: Li Er really did break the railing, and Zhou's Clerk saw it happen
text.zh: 李二真的弄坏了栏杆，周家伙计亲眼看见了

text.en: Zhou's Clerk made it up, and Li Er was not at the bridge that night
text.zh: 周家伙计编了瞎话，李二那晚根本不在桥边

text.en: The Zhou family spread it on purpose to ruin the name of the Li family
text.zh: 周家故意把话传出去，想坏了李家的名声

summary: 秋汛过去没多久，游灯必经的石桥便塌了一截栏杆。灯会还没开，李、周两家已经吵起来了，都说桥是对方弄坏的。

blocker.en: The Li family won't lend the bamboo

next.en: Find out what Granny Li heard, then follow the story back from person to person.
next.zh: 弄清李老太听到的是哪句话，再顺着传话的人问回去。

why.en: Granny Li heard the neighbours blame Li Er for the broken railing. She wants to hear what the Manager has to say first.
why.zh: 李老太听见街坊把断栏的事怪到李二头上，想先听听总管怎么说。

blocker.en: Granny Li still will not lend the bamboo
blocker.zh: 李老太还是不肯借竹料

next.en: Follow the story back and find out what each person heard before speaking in public.
next.zh: 顺着传话的人往回问，查清各人听见了什么，再当众说。

why.en: Granny Li will not lend it until the talk about Li Er is set straight in public.
why.zh: 李老太要等李二的事当众说清了，才肯借。

blocker.en: Li Da has not heard that the talk was set straight
blocker.zh: 李大还不知道那句闲话已经说清了

next.en: Tell Li Da what you set straight, then ask him to bring the bamboo to the bridge.
next.zh: 跟李大说说当时澄清了什么，再请他把竹料送到桥边。

why.en: Li Da wasn't there when the neighbours heard the correction. He hasn't heard it yet.
why.zh: 李大那会儿没在场，街坊当时听明白的话，他还没听见。

blocker.en: Li Da will not send the bamboo yet

next.en: Promise Li Da something, then ask again.
next.zh: 答应给李大一样东西，再请他送竹料。

next.en: Ask Li Da again when more of the town is with you.
next.zh: 等更多人站到你这边，再请李大送。

why.en: Li Da may still have doubts about you or be waiting for you to return a favour.
why.zh: 李大可能还信不过你，也可能在等你还上回的人情。

next.en: Check for the bamboo at the bridge when it's due.
next.zh: 到约好的时间，去桥边看看竹料到了没有。

next.en: Ask Li Da to bring the first load of bamboo to the bridge.
next.zh: 请李大把第一批竹料送到桥边。

next.en: Go to the Li house and ask Granny Li to lend the bamboo.
next.zh: 去李家，请李老太借竹料。

text.en: Get the first load of bamboo from the Li family
text.zh: 借到李家的第一批竹料

why.en: Li Da has promised to bring {bamboo_open} poles of bamboo to the bridge.
why.zh: 李大答应把{bamboo_open}根竹料送到桥边。

why.en: Granny Li has agreed. Ask Li Da when he can bring the bamboo to the bridge.
why.zh: 李老太点了头，接下来得问李大什么时候能把竹料送到桥边。

why.en: The Li family has the bamboo. Ask Granny Li if she'll lend it.
why.zh: 竹料在李家，得先问李老太肯不肯借。

next.en: Ask who passed it on, then check what that person actually said.
next.zh: 问传这句话的人是听谁说的，再去找那个人核对原话。

next.en: Start with Granny Li and find out how she came to hear it.
next.zh: 从李老太那儿问起，看看这话是怎么传到她耳朵里的。

text.en: Who said Li Er broke the railing?
text.zh: 谁说是李二弄坏的栏杆？

why.en: Once the talk about Li Er comes up, Granny Li won't discuss lending bamboo.
why.zh: 李老太一提起那句怪罪李二的话，就不肯再谈借料。

next.en: Use Compare in the notebook. The clerk saw Li Er, but does that establish who broke the railing?
next.zh: 在见闻簿里点「比一比」。伙计见过李二，凭这一点能认定是李二弄坏的栏杆吗？

text.en: What does the clerk's account tell you?
text.zh: 周家伙计看见的，能说明什么？

why.en: The clerk saw Li Er by the bridge. By the time the story reached the street, Li Er had supposedly broken the railing.
why.zh: 伙计只见到李二在桥边，传到街上却成了李二弄坏了栏杆。

next.en: Tell the room what each account says, then explain what the comparison shows.
next.zh: 把比过的两句话说给街坊听，再把你比出来的结果说明白。

text.en: Set the talk about Li Er straight in public

why.en: You've compared the accounts in the notebook. Granny Li and the neighbours still need to hear what you found.
why.zh: 你已经对过见闻簿里的话，李老太和街坊还得亲耳听一听。

next.en: Go to the teahouse at dusk and speak once the neighbours have arrived.
next.zh: 傍晚到茶馆，等街坊来了再开口。

text.en: To the teahouse tonight

why.en: The neighbours gather at the teahouse in the evening, when you can speak to them in person.
why.zh: 街坊傍晚会来茶馆坐坐，去了便有机会当面说。

next.en: Check for the bamboo at the bridge when it's due.
next.zh: 到约好的时间，去桥边看看竹料到了没有。

text.en: The bamboo that Li Da promised

why.en: Li Da said he'd bring the bamboo to the bridge.
why.zh: 李大答应按约好的时间送到桥边。

blocker.en: Li Da will not send another batch

next.en: Promise Li Da something, then ask again.
next.zh: 答应给李大一样东西，再请他送竹料。

next.en: Ask Li Da again when more of the town is with you.
next.zh: 等更多人站到你这边，再请李大送。

why.en: Li Da may still have doubts about you or be waiting for you to return a favour.
why.zh: 李大可能还信不过你，也可能在等你还上回的人情。

next.en: Check for the bamboo at the bridge when it's due.
next.zh: 到约好的时间，去桥边看看竹料到了没有。

next.en: Ask Li Da for another batch.
next.zh: 再请李大送一批。

text.en: Get the rest of the bamboo

why.en: The bridge needs {bamboo_need} bamboo poles. There are {bamboo_site} on site, and Li Da has promised {bamboo_open} more.
why.zh: 修桥要{bamboo_need}根竹料。桥边已有{bamboo_site}根，李大还答应送{bamboo_open}根。

why.en: The bridge needs {bamboo_need} bamboo poles. Only {bamboo_site} have arrived.
why.zh: 修桥要{bamboo_need}根竹料。桥边只有{bamboo_site}根。

blocker.en: Shopkeeper Zhou will not give the timber

next.en: Promise Shopkeeper Zhou something, then ask again.
next.zh: 先许周掌柜一件事，再请周掌柜送木料。

next.en: Ask Shopkeeper Zhou again when more of the town is with you.
next.zh: 等更多人站到你这边，再请周掌柜送木料。

why.en: The Zhou family sells timber for a living, and Shopkeeper Zhou hasn't agreed to supply the bridge.
why.zh: 周家的木料是拿来做买卖的，周掌柜还没答应拿出来修桥。

next.en: Check for the timber at the bridge when it's due.
next.zh: 到约好的时间，去桥边看看木料到了没有。

next.en: Ask Shopkeeper Zhou to bring the timber to the bridge.
next.zh: 请周掌柜把木料送到桥边。

text.en: Get the timber from the Zhou family

why.en: Shopkeeper Zhou has promised to bring {timber_open} poles of timber to the bridge.
why.zh: 周掌柜答应把{timber_open}根木料送到桥边。

why.en: The bridge needs {timber_need} poles of timber from the Zhou family's storehouse.
why.zh: 修桥还得从周家的库里调{timber_need}根木料。

blocker.en: {helper} has not agreed to come yet

next.en: Promise {helper} something, then ask again.
next.zh: 先许{helper}一件事，再请{helper}来帮忙。

why.en: {helper} wants something in return before joining.
why.zh: {helper}想先得点好处，才肯来帮忙。

next.en: Put out a call and see who comes to help at the bridge.
next.zh: 招呼一声，看看谁肯来桥边帮忙。

next.en: Ask someone from {needy} to help.
next.zh: 请{needy}的人来帮忙。

next.en: Ask one more person to help.
next.zh: 再请一个人来帮忙。

text.en: Find helpers

why.en: You'll need {crew} people at the bridge, with at least one from each family.
why.zh: 桥边得凑够{crew}个人，李家和周家至少各有一个人到场才行。

next.en: Wait for the rain to stop and come again in the morning.
next.zh: 等雨停，明早再来。

why.en: The rain's too heavy to work through, so the rest will have to wait until tomorrow morning.
why.zh: 这场雨下得没法动工，剩下的活只能留到明早。

next.en: Go to the bridge in the morning to check that work has started.
next.zh: 早上去桥边看看开工没有。

text.en: Work on the bridge, the third morning

why.en: You'll need more hands to finish the bridge on time.
why.zh: 照眼下的人手，再干下去也来不及，得再请几个人来搭把手。

why.en: This crew can finish the bridge in {work_mornings}.
why.zh: 这几个人再干{work_mornings}，就能把桥修好。

next.en: The bridge won't be ready for the festival, so it's time to prepare another route.
next.zh: 桥赶不上灯会了，得着手准备另一条路。

why.en: The rain has cost you the last morning of work.
why.zh: 这场大雨耽误了最后一次开工。

next.en: Go to the bridge in the morning to check that work has started.
next.zh: 早上去桥边看看开工没有。

text.en: Work on the bridge, the fourth morning

why.en: There's only tomorrow morning left, and the crew may be too small to finish in time.
why.zh: 只剩明早半天能干活，眼下人手少，恐怕来不及收工。

why.en: This is the last morning of work. With so few hands, the job may not get done in time.
why.zh: 能干活的时间就剩今早了，眼下人手少，恐怕来不及收工。

why.en: Tomorrow morning is the last chance to work, and this crew can finish in time.
why.zh: 明早是最后一次开工，眼下的人手够把桥修好。

why.en: This morning is the last chance to work, and this crew can finish in time.
why.zh: 今天上午是最后一次开工，眼下的人手够把桥修好。

blocker.en: The temple keeper will not open the lane yet

next.en: Promise the temple keeper something, then ask again.
next.zh: 先许庙祝一件事，再请庙祝打开夹道。

next.en: Ask the temple keeper again when more of the town is with you.
next.zh: 等更多人站到你这边，再请庙祝打开夹道。

why.en: The temple keeper has the key and usually keeps the lane locked.
why.zh: 庙后的夹道平日都锁着，能开门的钥匙在庙祝手里。

next.en: Wait a little, and the lane will be open.
next.zh: 等一会儿，夹道就开了。

next.en: Ask a few more people to help. The helpers hang the lanterns in the afternoon.
next.zh: 再请几个人来帮忙。下午帮手会去夹道挂灯。

next.en: Go behind the temple between 13:00 and 17:00, when the helpers will be hanging the lanterns along the lane.
next.zh: 13:00 到 17:00 去庙后看看，帮手会在那几个时辰沿着夹道挂灯。

next.en: Ask the temple keeper to open the lane behind the temple.
next.zh: 请庙祝打开庙后的夹道。

text.en: Get a detour ready

why.en: The temple keeper will open the gate. Once three people hang the lanterns, the lantern parade can take the lane.
why.zh: 庙祝肯开门了，等三个人把沿途的灯挂好，游灯队伍就能改走夹道。

why.en: The lane is open. Once three people hang the lanterns there, the parade can go that way.
why.zh: 夹道已经开了，只差三个人沿路挂灯，游灯队伍就能从那儿走。

why.en: The bridge may not be ready in time. The parade can take the lane behind the temple.
why.zh: 桥怕是来不及修了，游灯队伍可以改走庙后的夹道。

next.en: Look by the broken railing while it's still the second day. People passing through will soon wear away any marks.
next.zh: 趁第二天白天到桥边看一看，断栏旁的痕迹再晚些就要被来往的人踩没了。

next.en: Now that the water's gone down, look beneath the bridge to see what the river left exposed.
next.zh: 趁水退了，到桥墩下看看有没有露出来的东西。

next.en: The owner hasn't agreed to let you look at the boat, so start by going over for a chat.
next.zh: 船主还没答应让你看船，先去打声招呼再说。

next.en: The owner won't let you look at the boat yet. Try making a promise you can keep before you ask again.
next.zh: 船主还不肯让你看船，可以先许一件做得到的事，再问一回。

next.en: The boat's owner doesn't trust you yet. Go back for a chat tomorrow.
next.zh: 船主还信不过你。明天再去打个照面。

next.en: Look at the boat at the Ferry Landing.
next.zh: 去渡口看看那条船。

next.en: The watchman won't say what was seen. Try talking first.
next.zh: 更夫还不肯开口。先去聊几句。

next.en: The watchman won't talk about that night yet. Make a promise you can keep, then ask again.
next.zh: 更夫还不肯讲那晚的事。先许一件能做到的事，再开口问。

next.en: The night watchman does not trust you yet. Talk again tomorrow afternoon.
next.zh: 更夫还信不过你。明天下午再去聊聊。

next.en: Find the watchman at the Watch Post in the afternoon and ask what was seen on the rounds near the bridge that night.
next.zh: 等下午去更铺找更夫，问问巡到桥边时有没有瞧见什么。

next.en: Xiaoman won't talk about that night just yet. Start with a chat.
next.zh: 小满还不肯开口。先去聊几句。

next.en: Xiaoman won't talk about that night yet. Make a promise before you ask again.
next.zh: 小满还不肯讲那晚的事。先许一样东西，再问问。

next.en: Xiaoman does not trust you yet. Talk again tomorrow evening.
next.zh: 小满还信不过你。明天傍晚再去聊聊。

next.en: Xiaoman often goes down to the river to fish at night. Call at the house in the evening to ask if Xiaoman was nearby that night.
next.zh: 小满常在夜里去河边钓鱼，傍晚去家里问问，说不定那晚也在附近。

next.en: Come back to the bridge pier on the third morning, once the water has gone down.
next.zh: 等第三天早上水落下去，再到桥墩下看看。

next.en: The water has dropped. See what it exposed at the pier in daylight, then visit Xiaoman in the evening.
next.zh: 水退了，白天先看看桥墩下露出了什么，傍晚再去找小满。

next.en: See Xiaoman in the evening and ask what was seen that night.
next.zh: 傍晚去找小满，问问那晚看见了什么。

next.en: Go to the watch post on the fourth afternoon to ask what the watchman saw on the rounds near the bridge.
next.zh: 想知道更夫巡到桥边时看见了什么，第四天下午去更铺找人。

next.en: Find the night watchman at the watch post in the afternoon and ask what was seen that night.
next.zh: 下午去更铺找更夫，问问那晚看见了什么。

next.en: Check the bridge and Ferry Landing in daylight. Find Xiaoman in the evening. Ask the watchman on the fourth afternoon.
next.zh: 白天去桥上和渡口看看，傍晚找小满。第四天下午再找更夫。

text.en: How did the bridge really break?

why.en: Which account fits the marks left at the bridge? Look around by day, then ask people who were nearby that night.
why.zh: 哪种说法对得上桥上留下的痕迹？白天到桥边看看，再去问问那晚到过附近的人。

next.en: Check the marked part of the card. Find more evidence or revise that part before you speak again.
next.zh: 下回当众开口前，先看看讲稿上标的那一条。手里的凭据若对不上，就去找新的，或者把那条说法改过来。

next.en: Check a few more places and ask around. Speak again once you have evidence that can settle which account fits.
next.zh: 再去几处看看，也问问知情的人，等找到能分清两种说法的凭据，再当众讲一次。

next.en: The teahouse is fullest from 17:00 to 19:00. On the fifth day, speak before 18:00. You can also ask the elder in the morning to call the clan to the hall.
next.zh: 傍晚 17:00 到 19:00 茶馆里人最多，第五天得赶在 18:00 前说。也可以上午请族长把族人召集到祠堂。

next.en: Check a few more places for evidence. Bring what you find the next time you speak.
next.zh: 再去几处找些凭据。有了新凭据，再去当众讲。

next.en: Find the elder at the teahouse in the evening. Another option is to ask the elder to call a meeting at the Ancestral Hall.
next.zh: 傍晚去茶馆，族长在那儿。也可以请族长在祠堂召集族人。

next.en: Talk to the elder and keep any promises you've made, then return to the meeting with evidence that rules out the other account.
next.zh: 先跟族长说说话，把答应过的事办到，再带上能驳倒另一种说法的凭据去公议。

next.en: The elder has called a meeting at the Ancestral Hall. Go there to speak.
next.zh: 族长把族人召集到祠堂了。去祠堂当众说清楚。

next.en: Speak at the teahouse. It is fullest from 17:00 to 19:00. On the fifth day, speak before 18:00. You can also ask the elder in the morning to call the clan to the hall.
next.zh: 去茶馆当众说清楚。傍晚 17:00 到 19:00 那儿人最多，第五天得赶在 18:00 前说。也可以上午请族长把族人召集到祠堂。

next.en: You have spoken in public today. Come again next time.
next.zh: 今天已经当众说过了，下回再来。

next.en: Find out what belongs in the gaps on the card before you speak in public.
next.zh: 讲稿还有几处没填，等查明那些事再去当众讲。

next.en: The card is ready. Bring it to the public meeting on the fourth evening.
next.zh: 讲稿已经写好了，等第四天傍晚公议的时候再带去讲。

next.en: Look and ask until the card is complete. Then speak at the public meeting on the evening of the fourth day.
next.zh: 先去查、去问，把讲稿写全。第四天傍晚到公议上当众说清楚。

text.en: Tell the town how the bridge broke

why.en: The card marks the part of your account that didn't hold up last time. Check it again before you speak.
why.zh: 上回没说过去的那一条已经在讲稿上标出来了，下回开口前再核对一遍。

why.en: The evidence you brought last time fit several accounts, so people couldn't tell which one to believe.
why.zh: 你上回拿出的凭据也能解释别的说法，难怪大家听完还没点头。

why.en: Too few people were there last time, and the word did not carry.
why.zh: 上回在场的人太少，话传不开。

why.en: Not enough of the people who heard the account were convinced last time.
why.zh: 上回听完这番话，肯点头的人还不够多。

why.en: The elder missed your last statement. Give it again in person so the elder can hear it and agree.
why.zh: 上回族长没到场，还得再当面说一遍，请族长点头。

why.en: The elder heard you out last time, and your evidence held up. The elder may still believe a different account or have doubts about you.
why.zh: 上回族长听完了，凭据也够。族长可能还信着另一种说法，也可能信不过你。

why.en: Check what people said against the marks at the bridge. Then bring your evidence to the public meeting to explain how the railing broke.
why.zh: 先把现场的痕迹和各人的话对一遍，再带上凭据去公议，说清栏杆究竟怎么断的。

next.en: Set a table at the teahouse in the evening so the neighbours can see the two family heads sit down together.
next.zh: 傍晚在茶馆摆一桌饭，请两家当家当着街坊的面坐下来。

next.en: Pick another evening when the neighbours are there and invite both heads to share a table again.
next.zh: 另挑一个有街坊在场的傍晚，把两位当家的再请到同一桌。

next.en: Tell the town how the bridge broke first, then lay another table on another day.
next.zh: 先把桥的事当众说清楚，改天再摆一桌。

next.en: Set a table at the teahouse in the evening so the neighbours can see the two family heads sit down together.
next.zh: 傍晚在茶馆摆一桌饭，请两家当家当着街坊的面坐下来。

next.en: Go to the bridge between eight and noon. When the two households work side by side, their heads have a chance to cool down.
next.zh: 早上八点到中午到桥边去，两家的人一块儿干了活，当家的也能消点气。

next.en: Tell the neighbours how the railing broke, then invite both heads to share a table at the teahouse with other people there to see it.
next.zh: 把断栏的经过当众说清，再去茶馆摆一桌，请两位当家的当着街坊的面坐下来。

text.en: Make peace between the families

why.en: Things have eased between the families. People still need to see them sit down together.
why.zh: 两家已经没那么僵了，要让这事作数，还得有街坊亲眼看见两家坐下来。

why.en: The neighbours saw the two families share a table. Granny Li and Shopkeeper Zhou are still angry with each other.
why.zh: 街坊虽见过两家同桌，李老太和周掌柜心里还有气。

why.en: Now that the town has heard how the railing broke, it's a good time for Granny Li and Shopkeeper Zhou to sit down together.
why.zh: 大家既然已经听明白栏杆是怎么断的，也到了请两家当家的坐下来谈谈的时候。

why.en: The two heads are still angry with each other, and one meal will not settle it.
why.zh: 两家当家的心里还憋着气，一顿饭解不开。

next.en: Have the crossing ready before dark, then go to the bridge at dusk.
next.zh: 天黑前把过河的路安排好，傍晚再到桥边。

text.en: Festival night

why.en: Both families will need a way to take their lanterns across the river tonight. Get a route ready before dark.
why.zh: 今晚的游灯要过河，天黑以前得给李、周两家备好一条能提着灯走过去的路。

lapse.en: You let {pledge1_due} pass without giving {pledge1_to} {pledge1_what}. {pledge1_to} trusts you less, and people around town will hear why.
lapse.zh: 你答应最迟{pledge1_due}给{pledge1_to}的{pledge1_what}，没给成。{pledge1_to}更不信你了。这事还会在镇上传开。

next.en: Go to {pledge1_to} today and keep it in person.
next.zh: 今天去找{pledge1_to}，当面兑现。

next.en: Make good on your promise to {pledge1_to} in person by {pledge1_due}.
next.zh: {pledge1_due}去找{pledge1_to}当面兑现，早点去也行。

lapse.en: You let {pledge11_due} pass without giving {pledge11_to} {pledge11_what}. {pledge11_to} trusts you less, and people around town will hear why.
lapse.zh: 你答应最迟{pledge11_due}给{pledge11_to}的{pledge11_what}，没给成。{pledge11_to}更不信你了。这事还会在镇上传开。

next.en: Go to {pledge11_to} today and keep it in person.
next.zh: 今天去找{pledge11_to}，当面兑现。

next.en: Make good on your promise to {pledge11_to} in person by {pledge11_due}.
next.zh: {pledge11_due}去找{pledge11_to}当面兑现，早点去也行。

next.en: Go and tell Granny Li that the matter was set straight in public.
next.zh: 去告诉李老太，桥的事已经当众说清了。

next.en: Ask Granny Li for the bamboo again.
next.zh: 再请李老太借竹料。

next.en: Go to the bridge by day and see what was left by the broken railing.
next.zh: 白天去桥上看看断栏边留下了什么。

next.en: Look at the water under the bridge.
next.zh: 去看看桥墩下面的水面。

next.en: Zhou's Clerk passed by the bridge that night, so it's worth asking what the clerk saw.
next.zh: 周家伙计那晚从桥边走过，值得去问一问当时看见了什么。

next.en: The owner hasn't agreed to let you look at the boat, so start by going over for a chat.
next.zh: 船主还没答应让你看船，先去打声招呼再说。

next.en: The owner won't let you look at the boat yet. Try making a promise you can keep before you ask again.
next.zh: 船主还不肯让你看船，可以先许一件做得到的事，再问一回。

next.en: The boat's owner doesn't trust you yet. Go back for a chat tomorrow.
next.zh: 船主还信不过你。明天再去打个照面。

next.en: Look at the boat at the Ferry Landing.
next.zh: 去渡口看看那条船。

next.en: Xiaoman won't talk about that night just yet. Start with a chat.
next.zh: 小满还不肯开口。先去聊几句。

next.en: Xiaoman won't talk about that night yet. Make a promise before you ask again.
next.zh: 小满还不肯讲那晚的事。先许一样东西，再问问。

next.en: Xiaoman does not trust you yet. Talk again tomorrow evening.
next.zh: 小满还信不过你。明天傍晚再去聊聊。

next.en: Xiaoman often goes down to the river to fish at night. Call at the house in the evening to ask if Xiaoman was nearby that night.
next.zh: 小满常在夜里去河边钓鱼，傍晚去家里问问，说不定那晚也在附近。

next.en: The watchman won't say what was seen. Try talking first.
next.zh: 更夫还不肯开口。先去聊几句。

next.en: The watchman won't talk about that night yet. Make a promise you can keep, then ask again.
next.zh: 更夫还不肯讲那晚的事。先许一件能做到的事，再开口问。

next.en: The night watchman does not trust you yet. Talk again tomorrow afternoon.
next.zh: 更夫还信不过你。明天下午再去聊聊。

next.en: Find the watchman at the Watch Post in the afternoon and ask what was seen on the rounds near the bridge that night.
next.zh: 等下午去更铺找更夫，问问巡到桥边时有没有瞧见什么。

next.en: By day see the bridge and the ferry, in the evening Xiaoman, and on the fourth afternoon the night watchman. Once the card is complete, go and speak in public.
next.zh: 白天去桥上和渡口看看，傍晚找小满。第四天下午再找更夫。讲稿写全了，就去当众说清楚。

text.en: Find out how the bridge broke and say it in public
text.zh: 先把桥的事查清，当众说出来

why.en: The town has heard what happened at the bridge. Granny Li still won't lend the bamboo.
why.zh: 桥的事当众说清了，李老太却还没松口。

why.en: Granny Li won't lend the bamboo until the matter is cleared up in public. There are no rumours to follow, so start at the bridge and talk to anyone who might know something.
why.zh: 李老太说要等桥的事当众讲清，才肯借竹料。镇上没有现成的话头可追，得去桥边看看，再问问知情的人。

blocker.en: The elder will not call the clan yet

next.en: Talk with the elder first, so that the elder comes to trust you, then ask again.
next.zh: 先和族长聊几句，让族长信得过你。再请族长召集。

next.en: Promise the elder something, then ask again.
next.zh: 先许族长一件事，再请族长召集。

next.en: Ask the elder again tomorrow, when more of the town is with you.
next.zh: 等更多人站到你这边，明天再请族长召集。

why.en: The elder wants to know you better and to see part of the town behind you.
why.zh: 族长要先信得过你，也要看到镇上有人站在你这边。

next.en: Ask the elder at the Ancestral Hall in the morning to call a meeting. Show your evidence when the clan has gathered.
next.zh: 上午去祠堂请族长召集族人，再当着族人的面拿出凭据。

text.en: Ask the elder to call a meeting

why.en: The elder wants to see what evidence you have. You'll need the elder's trust and people in town to speak up for you.
why.zh: 族长要看你手头有些什么凭据。得让族长信得过你，镇上也得有人肯帮你说话。

variants.label: 船夫老何夜里撑船撞的，瞒着没说

text.en: In five days, see both families carry their lanterns across the bridge together
text.zh: 五天后，让李、周两家一起提灯过桥

text.en: Someone to stand up and set the record straight about Li Er
text.zh: 有人出来把「李二毁桥」这话当众说清

text.en: Wait for Granny Li's say-so before sending any bamboo
text.zh: 李老太点了头，竹料才能动

text.en: To be rid of the talk about the broken railing, and to find the lantern lost in the river
text.zh: 把毁桥的闲话说清，再找回掉进河里的灯笼

text.en: Get paid for the timber and call in the favours still owed
text.zh: 木料出了库就得有人结账。人情也得有人还。

text.en: Stop getting blamed for what happened to the bridge
text.zh: 别再有人把桥的事算到自己头上

text.en: To be left in peace with a jug of wine
A full house on festival night, and every piece of news going out first from the teahouse tables
text.zh: 灯会那夜茶馆满座，镇上的新鲜事头一个从茶桌上传出去

text.en: To be listened to when speaking of what is seen at night
text.zh: 夜里看到的事，也能有人听进去

text.en: To be left alone with the ferry
